version: main 055775da (opt-in INTARSIA_CUDA_FP8_GEMM_LT=1; study lane-pf/cuda-fp8-prefill, PR draft)
technique: W8A8 prefill projection GEMM on cuBLASLt's native e4m3 tensor-core path: activations quantised to e4m3 with the checkpoint's static per-tensor input_scale (RNE, saturating), weight and input scales passed as device-side A/B scale pointers, one cuBLASLt algorithm per (N, K) chosen at M=2048 with split-K pinned to 1 and no workspace so a row's bits do not depend on the call's M; falls back to the bf16 weight-only kernel when input_scale <= 0
mechanism: The default projection GEMM (gemm_reg) is a bf16-MMA register GEMM over e4m3-valued bf16 at 62-70 TFLOPS plus a separate quantiser pass; the e4m3 MMA roof on GB10 is 243 TFLOPS against 122 for bf16. Native e4m3 cuBLASLt reaches 131-143 TFLOPS (51-59 % of the e4m3 roof including the quantiser at 16k), cutting the fp8-projection class from 20 % to 11-12 % of prefill kernel time.
impact: 35B NVFP4 prefill tok/s, localeval x3 interleaved, same-window vLLM, spark2 (quiet slot #4575): default 5842 / 5422 at 4k / 16k vs vLLM 6465 / 6306 (-9.6 % / -14.0 %); lt at chunk 2048 6580 / 6066 (+12.6 % / +11.9 % over default, +1.8 % / -3.8 % vs vLLM); lt at chunk 8192 7020 / 6712 (+8.6 % / +6.4 % vs vLLM). Decode unchanged (83.8-84.0 / 81.3-81.7 / 73.8-74.2). Kernel time: fp8 projections 152 -> 82 ms (4189 tokens), 601 -> 286 ms (16014 tokens).
preconditions: sm_89+ with cuBLASLt e4m3 (CUDA 13 on sm_121)
checkpoint fp8 projections with static per-tensor input_scale and weight_scale (modelopt)
transfer_notes: Not bitwise the default kernel (different accumulation); KL against the vLLM goldens inside the floors and equal to the default's (short 5.4e-3 vs 4.7e-3, long 1.42e-2 vs 1.49e-2, 4k 1.21e-2 vs 1.22e-2) but the prefix-reuse continue rows fail at the recipe chunk on 2 of 5 prompts and the acc-short baseline gate fails, so it is NOT default-on. Row invariance of the GEMM itself holds (unit test, M down to 5). After lt the routed-expert kernel (41-47 % of kernel time, 22-33 % of the bf16 roof) is the largest class; chunk 8192 adds +6.7 % / +10.6 % on top.
